name: event_validity
description: Validity on historical layer events, including canonical confirmed, false_positive and not_affected. Finding kind and restatement operations are separate concepts.
note: Historical corrected and hardening remain schema-valid. not_verified is an audit-stage absence of an answer and is not an event validity.

definitions.corrected: Historical revision marker; import as a restatement, not a validity answer.
definitions.not_affected: The issue exists but does not apply to this repository, version or deployment.

corrected.note: The decision owner handles restatement semantics.
